## 1.0.0 (2026-11-07)

### ✨ New Features

* add default posts sort best patch ([85d87a0](https://github.com/sazap10/sync-patches/commit/85d87a075ac0b22f2693b8512b0698e91733a885))
* add disable crashlytics patch ([7bfb998](https://github.com/sazap10/sync-patches/commit/7bfb9989eaf1e62841d806bf12a2997befe35a1c))
* add opt-in crash logger patch ([46ba8cb](https://github.com/sazap10/sync-patches/commit/46ba8cb8bf83473a0f7a23dd4ff9b121991a785a))
* add skip onboarding patch ([28d2380](https://github.com/sazap10/sync-patches/commit/28d2380944c202e33a176483df44a1c9b373ab0d))
* raise sync for reddit target sdk to 36 ([46711cf](https://github.com/sazap10/sync-patches/commit/46711cf8ddfb192fad38d995efe1464f5c3e11ff))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* offset anchored bottom sheets for edge-to-edge insets ([2c31c3a](https://github.com/sazap10/sync-patches/commit/2c31c3abc2819cdd59e873eb88e20552f86530e1))
* prevent bottom sheet crash under forced edge-to-edge ([a218a75](https://github.com/sazap10/sync-patches/commit/a218a75acc41d27759c1138fb4d61389ec52e036))

patches.name: Default posts sort: Best
patches.description: Uses Best as the front page's posts sort until you choose a default posts sort in settings. Subreddits keep Hot, and sorts you saved for a feed are kept.

patches.name: Disable Crashlytics
patches.description: Stops Firebase Crashlytics from collecting and sending crash reports.

patches.name: Log crashes
patches.description: Writes every crash to a text file in Download/SyncCrashes, so crashes can be reported without adb.

patches.name: Skip onboarding
patches.description: Opens the main feed on first launch instead of Sync's welcome and setup screens.

patches.name: Target SDK 36
patches.description: Raises targetSdkVersion to 36. Adds export flags to runtime broadcast receivers, declares foreground service types and their permissions, opts out of predictive back, and fixes the toolbar-anchored bottom sheets under enforced edge-to-edge.
